summary: The exact candidate fixes the original GLM-5.3-Flash FP8 false-negative fusion gate by resolving the six source projection prefixes through the quantization configuration, while preserving TP-layout and partially-quantized rejection guards.

tests.what_was_measured: Original failure: all six source prefixes resolved to UnquantizedLinearMethod, but the recorded base's global quant_config gate disabled fusion.
Candidate regression, partial-quantization rejection, attention-TP mismatch rejection, and existing prefix boundaries; 7 tests passed.

tests.command: Independent Fp8Config prefix matrix using can_fuse_glm5_next_qkvbfg (candidate checkout)
tests.what_was_measured: Official parent-prefix and checkpoint-leaf exclusions enable fusion; missing/unrelated exclusions, TP mismatch, and unquantized-model behavior take the expected paths. The original first matrix intentionally exited 1 after finding the internal-qkv_proj conservative false negative; detailed follow-up resolved the naming distinction.

tests.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 independent BF16 fused primitive and real weight-loader comparisons (candidate checkout)
tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950, both fused stages and all eight loader-populated matrix results matched independent torch linear/bmm references exactly (max_abs 0.0).

gpu_execution.evidence: reports/j-377a616131c9/raw/gpu-inventory.txt identifies one AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950; gpu-fused-primitives.txt and gpu-loader-and-math.txt record exact BF16 agreement with independent PyTorch references.

remaining_counterexamples: An ignored_layers list using the internal fused name model.layers.0.linear_attn.qkv_proj (rather than checkpoint leaves q_proj/k_proj/v_proj or the parent linear_attn prefix) remains conservatively unfused. This does not match the original official-checkpoint configuration and cannot cause unsafe fusion.
remaining_limitations: Official GLM-5.3-Flash weights were unavailable, so full-model serving and semantic accuracy were not tested.
Only one gfx950 GPU was assigned, so the reported TP8 deployment and multi-node behavior were not reproduced.
GPU checks validate the changed fused primitives and their weight loaders, not complete GLM-5.3-Flash execution or performance.
No native source changed and the prepared environment specified no separate native artifact, so no native rebuild was applicable.
